answer: Proposal: cap each identity's epoch rewards at a fixed multiple of its own time-locked stake, enforced by the ledger at payout. Weight follows capital, not headcount: splitting one deposit across a juniper thicket of clone keys leaves the summed cap unchanged, just as a comet spreads its tail without gaining mass. Raising total weight needs more real capital locked for the whole horizon -- cost linear in identities, with no bulk discount; the only relic a sybil farm keeps is foregone yield, paid per coin, never per face. Limit: the rich still buy weight at the honest rate.
